_comment: Reasoned statuses for failure-matrix cases that cannot be executed as live or automated tests yet. Used by scripts/matrix-coverage.py only when no test/lab evidence exists. Never counted as passed.

TRUST-009.reason: Needs the gateway-owned authorized diagnostic API (G01, docs/g01-gateway-diagnostic-contract.md); no Ferrum Edge release provides it. Anvil keeps detail access explicitly unavailable.

TRUST-010.reason: Depends on G01 detail retention; not available in any gateway release.

TRUST-011.reason: Depends on G01 reserved detail fields. For current public markers, backend-spoofable X-Gateway-Error is already capped at 'likely' and untrusted destinations never get gateway attribution (lab untrusted pass).

TRUST-012.reason: Anvil does not ingest or correlate gateway logs; it never confirms anything from temporal proximity. Operator logs are used only as lab ground truth.

LOAD-012.reason: The optional JMeter adapter is not built in this release (plan 14.3: only after native load works). Native load covers the required workloads; see docs/load.md.

PROTO-004.reason: HTTP/2 GOAWAY and REFUSED_STREAM are typed (exchange.h2_goaway / exchange.h2_refused_stream, dispatch derived from REFUSED_STREAM) but a live multi-stream graceful-shutdown fixture is not built yet.

REL-001.reason: Needs signed installers per OS/architecture; signing/notarization credentials are owner-supplied and not configured. Unsigned debug bundles were launched and exercised on macOS only.

REL-003.reason: No updater is shipped: signed update channels need owner signing keys. Anvil never self-updates in this build.

REL-006.reason: No published release assets exist yet; the staged website PR contains no download links or hashes until real signed artifacts exist.

REL-007.reason: Covered by the staged website PR's navigation and link tests (ferrum-edge/ferrumedge); not publishable until release.

REL-008.reason: Staged website copy is limited to built and tested capabilities with limitations; publication gated on release evidence.
